01

About this website

This website introduces QIXARC, its services, research and products. You can contact the team at qixarc@gmail.com. QIXARC is based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.

02

Project enquiries

Submitting an enquiry starts a conversation. It does not confirm a booking or create a service agreement. Deliverables, fees, timelines, payment arrangements, ownership and support are agreed separately in writing for each project.

03

Products in development

Product descriptions explain the current direction. Features, availability and launch plans may change. A “Coming Soon”, alpha or development label is not a promise of a release date or production readiness. Product websites may have their own terms.

04

Content and permitted use

QIXARC branding and original website content remain with their respective owners. You may browse and share links to this site. Ask before reproducing its content or assets for commercial use. Some service artwork is conceptual illustration rather than a client project or an actual office photograph.

05

Responsible use

Please do not use the forms for spam, attempt unauthorised access or interfere with the website. Do not submit passwords, payment-card details, confidential customer records or other information that is unnecessary for an initial enquiry.

06

External links and availability

Links to social networks, portfolios and product websites take you to independently operated pages. Their content and availability can change. This website may also be updated or temporarily unavailable. Contact us if information appears incorrect.

07

Updates and contact

The date above identifies the latest revision. For a question about these website terms or an existing project agreement, contact qixarc@gmail.com.
